items.question: Are you free to discuss our project today or tomorrow?
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“Are you free to discuss our project today or tomorrow?”，自然应答是“I can discuss it today.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：C（I can discuss it today.）。
